text:
marisol: Heads-up team  launching a one-week "Lunchbox Shoutouts" drive the week of May 10. Goal: collect short peer recognitions for the monthly highlight reel. Plan is: drop a sign-up form, host two 20min drop-in cafe hours for help writing nominations, and publish a 1-page highlight email. Need volunteers for coverage and someone to approve copy.

devin: I can run one cafe hour Tue 12:15pm PT. Will do a live write-along for 10 mins.

tara: I'll do Wed 12:15pm PT session. Can we make both hybrid? Small room + zoom ok.

marisol: Yes hybrid. Room cap 16. We'll stream and record. Also want to add a simple checklist for what makes a standout nomination (impact, outcome, teammate quote). I'll draft that.

lucy: Happy to draft the checklist. Also can we add a short FAQ line about "who is eligible" and taxability? Managers keep asking.

finance-bot: Quick FYI: spot awards are processed as taxable income and reported on payroll; small tokens (<$50) may be non-reportable depending on local regs. See /handbook/rewards for details.

ops-bot: Nomination form updated: added "one-line impact" field and a toggle for anonymous posting. Form: https://forms.gle/lunchbox-shoutouts-2026

sam: I can sign up to approve the highlight copy and coordinate with Comms for the email send. Also can pick up boxed lunches for the in-person sessions if we need. Budget cap $180 per session.

marisol: Thanks Sam  we'll reimburse receipts. Please use project code REC-2026. I'll add that to the travel/expense note.

devin: For the cafe hours I'll prepare two example before/after nomination edits so folks see quick improvements. Short checklist + live edits should fit 20m.

lucy: I'll craft the blurb for calendar invites & Slack post. Draft blurb: "Bring a 1-line story about a teammate. Join us for quick help turning that into a nomination for our monthly highlight reel. Hybrid, limited in-person seating." Thoughts?

tara: Blurb looks good. Add: "All roles welcome; examples provided."

marisol: Final asks: volunteers for copy approval (sam), two hosts (devin + tara), checklist (lucy), pickups (sam), comms post (lucy). If you want to be listed as an example reader, reply here with your name.

sam: I'll take receipts and approve the final send. Also will confirm pickup time Thu morning if we need catering.

marisol: Great. I'll publish the sign-up and post in #general tomorrow. Please update the form with dietary needs by Fri EOD. Thanks everyone! :tada:
